THREE-EYED VISION
Architecture | Interior Design | Project Management | Vastu Shastra Consultant
Design that sees beyond the obvious.
TRAYAKSH ARCHITEQTS is an architecture and interior design practice founded on the belief that meaningful design begins with observation, understanding and a vision beyond the immediate.
We approach every project through a three-eyed vision—understanding the space, the people and the possibilities within it.

Our work is rooted in clarity, functionality and a sensitive relationship with nature. Through thoughtful planning, natural light, considered materials and restrained aesthetics, we create spaces that are contemporary yet timeless, refined yet comfortable.

We believe good design should not compete with life.
It should quietly make life better.
ABOUT TRAYAKSH ARCHITEQTS
Architecture with a deeper perspective.

TRAYAKSH ARCHITEQTS is a multidisciplinary design practice working across architecture, interior design and project management, with a growing portfolio of residential, commercial and retail projects.
Our practice is guided by a simple understanding: every space has a story, and every client has a different way of inhabiting it.
We do not begin with a predefined style. We begin by understanding the site, the context, the people and the purpose of the project. The design then evolves from these parameters.

Our approach is intentionally restrained. We value clear planning over visual excess, natural light over artificial intervention, and materials with character over unnecessary ornamentation. We look for opportunities to bring nature into the built environment and to create a sense of continuity between the inside and the outside.

Vastu Shastra also forms part of our holistic approach to spatial planning. Where relevant to the project and desired by the client, Vastu principles are thoughtfully considered alongside architectural planning, orientation, natural elements and functionality.
For us, minimalism is not about creating empty spaces. It is about removing what is unnecessary so that what truly matters can be experienced.
Every element—from the overall planning to the smallest detail—is considered for its purpose, proportion and relationship with the whole.

With experience across diverse project typologies and a background that combines architectural design with project management, TRAYAKSH ARCHITEQTS approaches projects from both creative and practical perspectives.
Our objective is simple:
To create spaces that are considered in design, precise in execution and enduring in experience.
THE TRAYAKSH PHILOSOPHY
Three-Eyed Vision
The name TRAYAKSH represents a three-eyed vision—a way of looking at architecture beyond its immediate appearance.
Every project is seen through three perspectives:
01 — SPACE
Understanding the physical world around us.
The site, its context, orientation, climate, light, landscape, proportions and inherent possibilities form the first layer of our design process.
02 — PEOPLE
Understanding those who will experience the space.
Their lifestyle, routines, aspirations, comfort, movement and individual identity shape the way the space is planned and detailed.
03 — POSSIBILITY
Looking beyond what is immediately required.
We explore how a space can become more adaptable, sustainable, efficient and meaningful over time.
THREE PERSPECTIVES. ONE VISION.
FOUNDER
Ar. Sharvari Pawaskar

Ar. Sharvari Pawaskar
Founder | Architect | Interior Designer | M.Arch. (Project Management)| Vastu Shastra Consultant

Ar. Sharvari Pawaskar is the founder of TRAYAKSH ARCHITEQTS, an architecture and interior design practice focused on thoughtful planning, minimal aesthetics and meaningful connections between people and their surroundings.
A 2018 graduate of Rachana Sansad's Academy of Architecture, Mumbai, she was a University Topper in Semester X and later pursued an M.Arch in Project Management, Mumbai.
Her experience spans residential, bungalow, commercial, office, salon, bank and retail projects, allowing her to approach design with both creative and practical perspectives.

Her design philosophy is rooted in minimalism, natural light, soothing colours, thoughtful materiality and a connection with nature. She believes that every element should have a purpose and that well-designed spaces should bring a sense of calm, balance and functionality to everyday life.
As a Vastu Shastra Consultant, she thoughtfully incorporates principles of spatial orientation and harmony into contemporary architecture and interiors wherever appropriate.
Through TRAYAKSH ARCHITEQTS, she strives to create spaces that are purposeful, balanced, quietly expressive and enduring.
VISION
Our Vision
To see architecture beyond form—to create spaces where people, nature and the built environment exist in balance.
We envision a future where design is thoughtful rather than excessive, timeless rather than trend-driven, and sustainable rather than wasteful.
Through our three-eyed vision, we seek to create spaces that are not only beautiful to look at, but meaningful to experience.
MISSION
Our Mission
Our mission is to create thoughtful, functional and timeless spaces by bringing together three essential perspectives:
Space — understanding context, climate, light, materials and functionality.
People — understanding lifestyles, needs, emotions and the way spaces are experienced.
Possibility — looking beyond the immediate brief to create sustainable, adaptable and future-conscious design.
Through architecture, interior design and project management, we strive to transform every project into a space that feels natural, purposeful and calm.
We design less for the moment, and more for the way life unfolds.
DESIGN PHILOSOPHY
Finding Calm in the Chaos
The world around us is constantly moving.
Our spaces don't have to.
We believe architecture and interiors can provide a sense of pause—a place where the mind feels lighter, the surroundings feel balanced and everyday life becomes more comfortable.
Our design philosophy is rooted in simplicity, functionality and sensory comfort.
We work with natural light, carefully considered colour palettes, honest materials, textures and greenery to create environments that feel calm without becoming monotonous.
We do not believe that a space needs more elements to become more beautiful.
Instead, we believe in understanding what the space truly needs—and allowing everything else to fall away.
OUR DESIGN PRINCIPLES
01 — PURPOSE
Every element should have a reason to exist.
02 — PROPORTION
We consider scale, balance and relationships between spaces rather than treating individual elements in isolation.
03 — LIGHT
Natural light is treated as an integral part of the architecture, shaping both atmosphere and experience.
04 — NATURE
Wherever the context allows, we seek to establish a relationship between the built environment and the natural world.
05 — MATERIALITY
Materials are selected not merely for appearance, but for their texture, longevity, character and relationship with the overall design.
06 — RESTRAINT
We believe thoughtful restraint often creates more enduring spaces than visual excess.
07 — FUNCTION
A well-designed space should work effortlessly for the people who use it.

OUR PROCESS
From Understanding to Experience
01 — UNDERSTAND
We begin by listening.
Understanding the client's requirements, lifestyle, aspirations, budget and expectations.
02 — OBSERVE
We study the site and its surroundings—the orientation, climate, context, light, views, existing conditions and opportunities.
03 — ENVISION
The information comes together to form a design direction that responds to both the practical and experiential aspects of the project.
04 — DEVELOP
The concept is translated into detailed planning, materials, lighting, furniture, architecture and technical documentation.
05 — COORDINATE
Design and execution are coordinated across consultants, contractors, vendors and site teams.
06 — REALISE
The final stage is where drawings become space—and the design begins to become part of everyday life.
